name: Seven Seas Fixes
author: byo-pop
description: Mends faults of the original Seven Seas Deluxe and leaves the game as it was: its look, rules, sounds and pace. Each fix is a toggle. Turn the mod off to play the original as it was. High scores and the saved game are shared with the original.

settings.label: Squares answer after "No" in the Continue dialog
settings.help: The original leaves the pirate's invisible box over board columns 1 to 4, rows 1 to 5 when a new game starts from the Continue dialog on Average or Hard, so those squares take no clicks and show no arrows for the whole game. On: the pirate is put away as when you Continue.
